root_cause_identification.expected_solution: Agent must identify dskit ring/ring.go::IsHealthy (and the heartbeat-owning ring/lifecycler.go) as the wrong-answer gate that lets a stale peer remain in the shuffle-shard set, AND tempo modules/ingester/instance.go::CutCompleteTraces with modules/ingester/flush.go::handleFlush as the saturation surface where the global block-builder lock contention prevents draining.
evaluation_criteria: Names dskit ring/ring.go IsHealthy (or equivalent ring health gate) as the source of the wrong answer
Names tempo modules/ingester/instance.go (CutCompleteTraces) as the live-traces accumulator
Mentions modules/ingester/flush.go::handleFlush and the block-builder lock contention
States that a stale-but-not-yet-evicted peer or shuffle-shard degeneracy is what funnels load to one ingester

error_chain_trace.expected_solution: Agent must trace at least four hops: distributor shuffle-shard call -> dskit ring IsHealthy returns wrong answer for stale peer -> shuffle-shard set degenerates so the same hot ingester is picked -> ingester's CutCompleteTraces / handleFlush falls behind under lock contention -> live trace count spikes to the 3M cap while peers stay flat.
evaluation_criteria: Mentions distributor shuffle-shard / replication selection as the entry point
Mentions dskit ring IsHealthy returning the wrong answer (or stale heartbeat / unhealthy timeout)
Mentions that the same hot ingester is repeatedly selected (shard degeneracy / funneling)
Mentions instance.go CutCompleteTraces or flush.go handleFlush falling behind, ending in the live-traces spike

affected_components.expected_solution: Agent must name the Tempo distributor, the Tempo ingester, and the dskit ring as the affected components.
evaluation_criteria: Names the Tempo ingester (modules/ingester / instance.go / flush.go)
Names the dskit ring (ring/ring.go / ring package)

remediation_proposal.expected_solution: Agent must propose at least one concrete remediation: (a) tighten dskit IsHealthy / shuffle-shard so a stale-but-not-yet-evicted peer is excluded; (b) make shuffle-shard saturation-aware so it skips an ingester that is at its live-traces cap; OR (c) reduce block-builder lock contention in modules/ingester/flush.go::handleFlush so the funneled ingester can drain.
evaluation_criteria: Proposes one of: tightening IsHealthy/heartbeat semantics, shuffle-shard saturation awareness, or block-builder lock contention fix
Identifies where the fix would live (dskit ring, Tempo distributor shuffle-shard caller, or Tempo ingester flush path)
